description: Na₂Ba₂SrAl₄F₂₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.84 Å. Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.70-3.04 Å. Sr is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.56 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 31°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.88 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 31°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.88 Å. There are ten inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two Al atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Al atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Al atoms. In the ninth F site, F is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing FBa₂NaAl tetrahedra. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Al atom.
